name: delta like non-canonical Notch ligand 1

function.text: DLK1 encodes protein delta homolog 1 [Cleaved into: Fetal antigen 1]. Annotated molecular activities include calcium ion binding. It participates in cell differentiation and negative regulation of ossification.
